assets.primaryRequest: one compact stone engineering workshop evolved from the engineer camp
assets.structureRequest: one single-storey stone hall, one uninterrupted terracotta gabled roof, one short attached chimney, one open wooden double-door work bay, one timber-and-iron geared hoist, one tool bench and one small attached wordless gear emblem; warm gray fieldstone walls, muted brick-red terracotta roof, dark oak doors and work equipment, matte black iron and a small dull brass gear
assets.detailRequest: The entire masked patch is uninterrupted solid gray STONE MASONRY WALL. Erase the arched window, all glass, the entire timber frame, sill, lintel and shadow. Replace them with ordinary gray stone blocks and matching mortar continuing seamlessly from the neighboring wall, with identical stone size, color, perspective and lighting. This is a blank stone wall repair patch, not an opening. Absolutely no window, door, niche, panel, frame, ornament, glowing area or sign anywhere inside this mask. Everything outside the mask including the open main door and foreground tool rack remains exactly unchanged.
assets.negativeRequest: Inside the mask: no window, frame, arch, inset panel, electrical box, illumination or ornaments. Outside the mask: no changes.
